name: 2D Cartoon Animation
visual_style: Original hand-drawn-inspired 2D cartoon, crisp consistent outlines, cel shading and layered illustrated backgrounds.
camera: Controlled 2D pans, zooms and parallax; clear compositions.
lighting: Consistent illustrated shadow language and controlled palette.
motion: Strong readable key poses, expressive timing and consistent character model sheets.
consistency: Maintain subject identity, geometry, wardrobe, environment and all distinctive details across frames. Avoid morphing, duplicate limbs, unwanted object changes and camera jumps.
negative_guidance: Avoid flicker, temporal inconsistency, deformations, unnatural body motion, random text, unintended logos and watermarks.
